FIELDS.NAME: Solid Foundations Concrete & Masonry Services
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: At Solid Foundations Concrete & Masonry Services, we specialize in delivering high-quality residential and commercial concrete and masonry solutions. Our operations include the installation and repair of concrete slabs, foundations, retaining walls, brickwork, and various masonry structures. We pride ourselves on using reliable materials while adhering to strict safety protocols, ensuring all projects are completed on time and to the highest standards. Our seasoned team is committed to ongoing training and scheduled inspections to maintain a strong safety record and minimize risks. With a focus on proactive risk management, we consistently evaluate our operations to comply with local building codes and regulations, thereby safeguarding our clients and stakeholders.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On March 10, 2022, during the installation of a concrete foundation for a residential property, an employee sustained a minor injury due to improper lifting techniques, resulting in $2,500 in medical expenses. The incident was reported, and necessary safety training was reinforced among the team to prevent future occurrences. The claim has been closed, with no ongoing issues.
FIELDS.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday to Friday, 7:00 AM to 5:00 PM; Saturday, 8:00 AM to 3:00 PM; Closed on Sunday
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Security fencing and 24-hour watchperson services for all job sites to ensure safety and reduce theft or vandalism risks.
